# 勘 (かん) - intuition; hunch

## Meaning

勘 is a noun for intuition, a hunch, or an intuitive feel for something. It can concern a quick guess or an ability developed through experience. Use **勘で** for doing something by intuition rather than through an explicit calculation.

- 答えが分からなかったので、勘で選びました。 (こたえがわからなかったので、かんでえらびました。) - I did not know the answer, so I chose by intuition.
- 私の勘が当たりました。 (わたしのかんがあたりました。) - My hunch was right.

勘が当たる (かんがあたる) says the hunch proves right; 勘が外れる (かんがはずれる) says it proves wrong.

## How the kanji combine

[勘](../kanji/勘.md) is a single kanji used as the whole noun, with the on reading カン. There is no multi-kanji compound to break down.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[予想](予想.md) (よそう) is an expectation or prediction and need not come from intuition. [判断](判断.md) (はんだん) names a judgment; 勘 can be one basis for making it. Neither word is an exact opposite.

## Distinctive meaning

勘がいい, "have good intuition," and 勘が鋭い (かんがするどい), "have sharp intuition," describe sensitivity to clues. They do not assert supernatural powers or guarantee correctness. 久しぶりで勘が鈍った (ひさしぶりでかんがにぶった) means one's feel for an activity has become rusty after a long break.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1210590, sense 1.

# 勘定 (かんじょう) - reckoning; bill

## Meaning

勘定 is counting or reckoning, and 勘定する means to count or calculate something. It also names a bill or the settlement of a bill, especially in expressions with お.

- 人数を勘定しました。 (にんずうをかんじょうしました。) - I counted the people.
- お勘定をお願いします。 (おかんじょうをおねがいします。) - The bill, please.

In the first example, を marks what is counted. In the second, the speaker is asking to settle the bill, not requesting an abstract mathematics calculation.

## How the kanji combine

[勘](../kanji/勘.md) contributes examining or reckoning, and [定](../kanji/定.md) contributes settling or determining. Together they suggest determining an amount or account. The on readings are カン + ジョウ.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[計算](計算.md) (けいさん) covers calculation more broadly. [会計](会計.md) (かいけい) overlaps in payment and accounting contexts. [支払う](支払う.md) (しはらう) directly means "pay," whereas 勘定 can name the amount or the counting process.

## Distinctive meaning

勘定に入れる (かんじょうにいれる) means "take into account"; 勘定に入れない means "leave out of the reckoning." This is the consideration sense, not a general replacement for every use of "think." Context distinguishes counting participants, paying a restaurant bill, and allowing for a factor in a decision.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1210750, senses 1-3.

# 勘違い (かんちがい) - mistaken assumption; misunderstanding

## Meaning

勘違い is a mistaken understanding, assumption, or guess.
勘違いする means to get the wrong idea.
Use clause + と勘違いする to state what someone mistakenly believed.

- 会議は明日だと勘違いしていました。
  (かいぎはあしただとかんちがいしていました。) - I had mistakenly thought the meeting was tomorrow.
- 私の勘違いでした。
  (わたしのかんちがいでした。) - I had the wrong idea.

In the first example, と follows the full mistaken claim, 明日だ.
XをYと勘違いする means mistaking X for Y.

## How the kanji combine

[勘](../kanji/勘.md) contributes judgment or intuition, and
[違](../kanji/違.md) contributes being different or mistaken.
The word combines カン with native 違い (ちがい), related to
[違う](違う.md). This is a mixed on-first compound, not two on readings.

## Synonyms and antonyms

[誤解](誤解.md) (ごかい) overlaps in a misunderstanding or wrong
interpretation. [間違い](間違い.md) (まちがい) is broader:
a copying error need not involve a mistaken belief about the situation.
These distinctions do not make every use mutually exclusive.

## Distinctive meaning

勘違い does not necessarily imply deliberate deception.
The speaker may genuinely have assumed the wrong date, person, or meaning.
Do not infer that 勘違い is always harmless or only concerns another
person's words; context determines the consequences and what was mistaken.

Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project),
entry 1210620, sense 1.

# 定 — determine; settle

**Strokes:** 8 · **Key (radical):** 宀 (no. 40) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

定 concerns something being decided, established, or fixed. In [予定](../words/予定.md) (よてい), the idea is something arranged in advance: a plan or schedule.
A plan can still change; 定 in this compound does not guarantee that the event will happen.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** imagine the long lower sweep leading to a fixed destination beneath the roof.
This is a visual prompt for "settled," not an origin claim.

## Readings

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| テイ | on | [予定](../words/予定.md) (よてい) — plan; schedule |
| ジョウ | on | [定規](../words/定規.md) (じょうぎ) — ruler |
| さだ.める | kun | 定める (さだめる) — determine; establish |
| さだ.まる | kun | 定まる (さだまる) — become settled |

## Common words

- [予定](../words/予定.md) (よてい) — plan; arrangement
- 定める (さだめる) — decide; establish something
- 定まる (さだまる) — become fixed or settled
- [定規](../words/定規.md) (じょうぎ) — measuring ruler
- [勘定](../words/勘定.md) (かんじょう) — reckoning; bill; 定 has the on reading ジョウ here

## Notes

定める takes an object; 定まる describes something becoming settled. Compare 日を定める (ひをさだめる), "set a date," with 日が定まる (ひがさだまる), "the date becomes settled."
[足](足.md) and [走](走.md) resemble parts of the lower outline, but 定 has 宀 at the top.

Sources: [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project); [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entries 1543240, 1435380, 1435370, 1435520.

# 違 — differ

**Strokes:** 13 · **Key (radical):** 辵 (as 辶, no. 162) · **JLPT:** N3 (community list)

## Meaning and origin

違 marks a difference or mismatch. [違う](../words/違う.md) ちがう can simply mean "be different," without judging either thing as bad.
In a correction it can also mean "be wrong"; context determines which interpretation fits.

**Modern-shape mnemonic:** notice the central 口 between the bars of 韋, all riding on 辶.
Picture the bars not lining up with a matching pattern. This is only a mnemonic.

## Readings

The table selects useful readings; the metadata preserves the complete source reading list.

| Reading | Type | Typical words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ちが.う | kun | [違う](../words/違う.md) ちがう — differ; be wrong |
| ちが.い | kun | 違い ちがい — difference |

## Common words

- [違う](../words/違う.md) ちがう — differ; be incorrect
- 違い ちがい — difference
- 間違う まちがう — make a mistake
- [勘違い](../words/勘違い.md) かんちがい — mistaken assumption; 勘 has on カン and 違い is native ちがい here

## Notes

色が違う (いろがちがう) means "the colors are different," not necessarily "the colors are wrong."
[遠](遠.md) also has a small central box, but its lower strokes spread differently.
The table selects native readings; the on reading イ remains in the metadata.
